meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 把旧版记忆文件(CLAUDE.md、.seed.md 等)搬到统一的共享记忆树,按类型整理进索引和概念文件,常驻指令合并进 instructions.prepend.md。迁移前请用户确认,迁移后生成源到目标对照报告与差异供审阅。
howto.when: 在系统更新报告共享记忆出现破坏性变更后,或组里仍留有旧版记忆文件(.seed.md、CLAUDE.md 等)时触发;用户说出“migrate memory”“legacy memory”等关键词也会启动。

say.note: 开始把旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树。

say.text: 帮我把旧版 CLAUDE.md 记忆合并进共享树
say.note: 先列出受影响组,确认后才会动手。

say.text: 切换后 agent 什么都忘了,恢复一下记忆
say.note: 会扫描遗留记忆文件并整理,结束后可验证。

howto.what_en: Migrates legacy memory files into a shared indexed memory tree, merges standing instructions into instructions.prepend.md, asks approval before moving, and outputs a source-to-destination report with a reviewable diff.
howto.when_en: Triggers after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, when a group still has legacy memory files (.seed.md, CLAUDE.md, etc.), or on keywords like "migrate memory" and "legacy memory".

say_en.note: Starts migrating legacy memory into the shared tree.

say_en.text: Merge my old CLAUDE.md memory into the shared tree
say_en.note: Lists affected groups and asks approval first.

say_en.text: The agent forgot everything after the switch — restore it
say_en.note: Scans and migrates leftover legacy memory files.
